verdict.rationale: Vercel ships event-driven building blocks rather than a general rule-to-action engine. Webhooks deliver deployment and project events as HTTP POSTs, but you must write the handler that acts on them. Git pushes automatically trigger deployments, Workflows can wait for external events, and Firewall custom rules block traffic that matches conditions. Each of these covers a fixed or narrow event type, so arbitrary event-triggered automation still needs custom code. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rules engine mapping arbitrary platform events to actions, documentation of conditional trigger logic beyond firewall and deploy rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
